_comment: Steps OCILB/CSLB/DBPR apply to HVAC and plumbing applicants alike, shown once on /state/california. Each item names the registered documents that contain it. replacesSteps: the verbatim record steps these stand in for (kept off the summary pages).

items.text: After passing the exam(s), pay the initial license fee: $200 for a sole owner, $350 for a non-sole owner.
File a contractor bond with CSLB before the license is issued.

replacesSteps: After passing, pay the initial license fee ($200 sole owner / $350 non-sole owner) and file the required $25,000 contractor's bond with CSLB.
Await processing. The board does not publish a processing time.
